No supplied event outcome supports assigning directional event pressure before the event.

Bearish reversal-pattern evidence coexists with deterministic transition rather than a confirmed breakdown.
Volume contraction weakens confirmation of either a recovery or a decisive downside continuation.
Scheduled earnings can reclassify volatility and structure over the classification horizon.
